    """Test that a Slider widget can be pickled and unpickled."""
    print("Testing Slider pickle...")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    slider = widgets.Slider(ax, 'Test', 0.0, 1.0, valinit=0.5)
    
    # Pickle the widget itself
